title: Unbundling the ethical and social issues in human neural organoid research
title_zh: 人神经类器官研究中的伦理和社会问题解构
abstract: As human neural organoid research advances, some key concepts in its ethical analysis need to be unbundled to keep pace with scientific developments. These include interests involved in informed consent, distinct dimensions of consciousness and their implications for welfare, approaches to engaging public concerns, and governance and oversight of both organoids themselves and their uses.
abstract_zh: 随着人神经类器官研究的进展，其伦理分析中的一些关键概念需要进行解构，以跟上科学研究的发展。这些包括知情同意所涉及的利益、意识的不同维度及其对福祉的影响、公众关切的参与方式，以及对类器官本身及其用途的治理与监督。
